notes.title: Minor update: Steamworks
notes.content:
Some players have reported issues with achievements not working properly, it's been tricky to test for since there doesn't seem to be a very clear pattern as to why it's only for some people.
I've updated Game Maker's steamworks extension to the most recent version in hopes that it'll work a little more smoothly and mitigate this issue (maybe even fix it entirely? boy wouldn't that be nice lol)

Thanks again for all your feedback and patience!

notes.title: Version 1.0.7, very minor fix to the gallery
notes.content: Some gallery buttons were set unlock at incorrect progression flags, such as the connect four minigame's unlocks actually being attached to the matching minigame's progression flags.

notes.title: Version 1.0.6
notes.content:
All previous fixes from version 1.0.5 are present here, but the game doesn’t INSTANTLY CRASH ON BOOTUP.
The reason this was happening was because it would DELETE the file that stores all of the dialogue in the game on startup, total bonehead move on my part.
If you have v1.0.5 on Steam make sure to update and “validate” the files so it can ensure you have the “library.csv” file.

Thank you all so much for your continued patience!

notes.title: Minor patch (v1.0.5)
notes.content:
-Fixed Vera repeating her advice at the end of the game

-Fixed Bandit softlock

-Fixed Connect Four softlock

-Fixed being able to remove inactive runes in the codebreaker minigame

Huge thank you to everyone for your support and patience!
